panel.title: Dashboard
panel.profileTooltip: Choose a GIF or image for the dashboard profile

settings.panelDetachedDesc: When disabled, the dashboard opens as an attached panel while still respecting the options below.
settings.panelPositionDesc: Controls the edge or center used when the dashboard is not following the bar.
settings.followBarEdgeDesc: When attached, automatically uses the same edge as the bar. Disable this to choose the position manually.
settings.panelWidthDesc: Base width before UI scale is applied.
settings.panelHeightDesc: Base height before UI scale is applied.
settings.avatarPathDesc: Local path used only by this dashboard. GIF files animate in the profile card.
settings.avatarShapeDesc: Controls whether the profile avatar is circular or a rounded square.
settings.profileCardShapeDesc: Sets the visual clipping shape of the main profile box.
settings.panelScaleDesc: Adjusts the dashboard size without changing the whole shell scale.
settings.dashboardMusicEffectsDesc: Player and profile visuals inside the dashboard.
settings.followNoctaliaPerformanceModeDesc: When Noctalia performance mode is active, the dashboard disables animations and effects.
settings.powerSaverPerformanceModeDesc: When the system power profile is power saver, the dashboard enters light mode. Balanced and performance keep your configured effects.
settings.mediaVisualizerEffectDesc: Animated effect inside the media card while music is playing.
settings.audioSliderEffectDesc: Animated shape drawn as the volume slider itself while media is playing.
settings.microphoneSliderEffectDesc: Animated shape drawn as the input slider itself when the microphone captures signal.
settings.avatarMusicEffectDesc: Visual reaction around the profile GIF when music is playing.
settings.profileDanceGifPathDesc: Local path for the GIF shown in the free space of the profile card. GIFs pause when no music is playing.
settings.showProfileWallpaperDesc: Uses the current monitor wallpaper as the dashboard profile card background.
settings.profileCoverModeDesc: Controls the background source for the profile card.
settings.profileCoverPathDesc: Local image or GIF used as the profile card background.
settings.profileCoverFolderDesc: Picks a random image from this folder every time the dashboard opens.
settings.profileCoverOverlayDesc: Adjusts the layer over the image to keep text readable in light and dark themes.
settings.profileCoverOverlayEnabledDesc: Allows the dark layer over the cover to be fully disabled.
settings.profileCoverBlurEnabledDesc: Applies visual blur to the profile background image.
settings.profileCoverBlurDesc: Blur strength applied to the profile cover.
settings.profileCoverBorderDesc: Draws a decorative border around the profile card.
settings.profileCoverBorderWidthDesc: Visual thickness of the profile card border.
settings.profileCoverBorderColorModeDesc: Uses Noctalia colors automatically or a custom palette.
settings.profileCoverBorderColorCountDesc: Controls whether the custom palette uses 3, 4, or 5 colors.
settings.profileCoverBorderAnimationDesc: Constant effects always run; reactive effects depend on music.
settings.profileCoverBorderSpeedDesc: Controls the speed of constant and reactive border effects.
settings.barMediaWidgetDesc: Turns the dashboard button into a mini player when music is playing.
settings.showBarMediaInfoDesc: When music is playing, the widget shows cover art, title, and artist instead of the simple icon.
settings.barMediaShowWhenPausedDesc: Keeps showing the track in the bar even when playback is paused.
settings.barMediaShowAlbumArtDesc: Displays the track cover inside the bar widget.
settings.barMediaShowProgressRingDesc: Draws track progress around the cover art.
settings.barMediaShowVisualizerDesc: Uses the real audio spectrum as the bar widget background.
settings.barMediaVisualizerTypeDesc: Same visualizer styles used by Noctalia MediaMini.
settings.barMediaShowArtistFirstDesc: Shows Artist - Track instead of Track - Artist.
settings.barMediaScrollingModeDesc: Controls when the track name scrolls inside the widget.
settings.barMediaLayoutDesc: Controls whether cover art and text sit before or after the dashboard icon.
settings.barMediaMaxWidthDesc: Maximum width for the dashboard mini player in the bar.
settings.barMediaUseFixedWidthDesc: Keeps the widget at the configured maximum width.
settings.iconNameDesc: Tabler icon name used by the dashboard bar button.
settings.componentColorsIntroDesc: Use All components for a global adjustment or pick one component for fine tuning. When disabled, Noctalia keeps choosing automatically.
settings.componentStyleTargetDesc: Selects whether the adjustment applies globally or to a specific dashboard area.
settings.componentStyleEnabledDesc: When disabled, this component uses Noctalia's automatic colors.
settings.componentBackgroundDesc: Main color of this component card or capsule.
settings.componentTextDesc: Color for titles and higher-emphasis information.
settings.componentSubtextDesc: Color for details, descriptions, and lower-emphasis values.
settings.componentAccentDesc: Color used by indicators, graphs, rings, and active states.
settings.componentButtonBackgroundDesc: Base color for internal buttons in this component.
settings.componentButtonTextDesc: Color for icons and text shown over internal buttons.
settings.componentBorderEnabledDesc: Applies the decorative border to this component without changing the others.
settings.componentBorderWidthDesc: Visual thickness of the custom border.
settings.componentBorderScopeDesc: Chooses whether the effect applies to the main box, inner items/buttons, or everything.
settings.componentBorderColorModeDesc: Uses Noctalia's automatic palette or custom colors for this component.
settings.componentBorderAnimationDesc: Constant effects always run; reactive effects depend on music.
settings.componentBorderSpeedDesc: Controls this component border animation speed.
